item.text:
For OCR file uploads, Mistral supports:

- PDF
- PNG
- JPG/JPEG
- TIFF
- BMP
- GIF
- WEBP

The maximum individual upload size is 512 MB. ZIP archives are not supported, so a `.zip` upload returns `422 Invalid file format`; extract the archive and upload the supported files individually. [Mistral’s known limitations](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations) · [Files API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files)
